sources.title: A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models
sources.snippet: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) reorganizes the training loop around this observation by having the teacher provide feedback on what the student actually produces, with the goal of reducing the compounding term toward linear and reframing distillation as an iterative correction process rather than single-pass imitation.
